individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster image overlaid on a tissue section, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel is a micrograph/spatial image, not a plot.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel B shows H&E images with manual annotation, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel is a micrograph, not a plot.

individual-data-points.explanation: The spatial expression maps show individual spot-level mRNA expression values across the tissue (each spot is an individual data point), not an averaged summary statistic.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The spatial expression heatmaps display per-spot log2 expression values with a color scale; there are no error bars or summary statistics requiring definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots display the running enrichment score across the ranked gene list along with the ranked gene hits (barcode plot below), which is the standard and complete representation for this analysis type; no averaging across replicates is being summarized here.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present in the GSEA enrichment plots; NES, FDR and P values are reported instead and statistical methodology (bootstrapping with 1000 permutations) is described in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values (a single summary statistic per gene derived from differential expression analysis) without showing individual data points or any indication of variance across samples/spots.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph presents single fold-change values per gene with P values annotated but no error bars are shown or defined, despite this being an average/summary statistic derived from differential expression testing across spots.
